name: HUD
description: Switches lid-hud.dll (LiD HUD) on and off, and writes its Enemies Left counter's words in every language the game has. The plugin adds durability numbers on the weapon bars (with low-durability colours and change pop-ups), the Enemies Left counter, floor info (beasts, mushrooms, chests and materials left, and a Fun Fungus line), rage, bag space, mushroom effect timers, run totals (time, Kill Coins, SP, Bloodnium, EXP, Death Metals, deaths and continues), an always-on minimap, the bow arc, escalator colours on the area map, and hiding the Serial Killer distortion. Press F8 in the game to move, size and set every part - see the readme.
author: KSFA
